name: Living with My Sisters 2
source:
Welcome back to Living with My Sisters 2, where passion and pleasure await! In this thrilling sequel, MC explores new romantic connections with their step-sisters, Eve and Fiona, in a steamy polyamorous relationship that will leave you breathless. But when the sexy and alluring Victoria, the MC's step-cousin, enters the picture, things get even hotter and more intense.

Experience the tantalizing storyline, gorgeous visuals, and engaging characters as you make choices that will lead you down the path of sensual pleasure and thrilling romance. Victoria, who has always had a crush on MC, gets the support she needs from Eve to come out and explore her feelings. But Fiona might pose a bit of a challenge to Victoria's crush on MC. How will things play out in the end? 

With new places for characters to "have fun" together, you can immerse yourself in a world of intimate moments and sizzling encounters. Join our community of passionate fans and explore the limitless possibilities of love and lust in this exciting visual novel. Play now and let your desires run wild!

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/living-with-my-sister-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
歡迎回到《Living with My Sisters 2》，激情與歡愉正在等待！在這部令人興奮的續作中，主角與繼姊妹Eve、Fiona建立新的情感連結，展開一段讓人屏息的火熱多重戀情。然而，當性感迷人的繼親表親Victoria加入，事情變得更加熾熱、更加激烈。

體驗撩人的劇情、精美的畫面與引人入勝的角色，做出選擇，走向感官歡愉與刺激愛情的道路。一直暗戀主角的Victoria，在Eve的支持下，終於鼓起勇氣表明心意、探索自己的感情。但Fiona可能會給她的暗戀帶來一些挑戰。事情最終會如何發展？

角色們將有更多地方可以一起「玩樂」，讓你沉浸在親密時刻與火熱邂逅之中。加入熱情的粉絲社群，在這部精彩視覺小說中探索愛與慾的無限可能。現在就開始遊玩，讓慾望自由馳騁！
